answer: An identity bond that decays unless renewed stops cheap fakes. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day expected earnings; it loses 10% every epoch unless the agent finishes one attested honest task, cheap for a real agent. The fable of the nebula miners warns: forging 100 identities means funding 100 bonds and repeating the renewal work 100 times, while one honest agent pays once and signs its record with its own quill.
